import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int check(int n) {
        if (n == 2) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static int ans(int n, int m) {
        Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();
        mp.put(0, 0);
        mp.put(1, 1);
        mp.put(2, 2);
        mp.put(3, 3);
        mp.put(4, 2);
        mp.put(5, 1);

        if (m == 1) {
            return mp.get(n % 6);
        }
        if (m == 2) {
            if (n == 3) {
                return 2;
            }
            if (n == 2) {
                return 4;
            }
            if (n == 7) {
                return 2;
            }
        }
        return (n * m) % 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();

        int n1 = n;
        int m1 = m;

        if (n < m) {

            n = m;
            m = temp;
        }
        System.out.println(n * m - ans(n, m));

}
